alexcrichton opened PR #14586 from alexcrichton:requeue-work to bytecodealliance:main:

When a run_concurrent future is dropped we'll properly clean up all resources associated with it, however Wasmtime will end up losing work if the store is resumed later and wasn't otherwise executing any wasm. This replaces the preexisting Drop-guard with one that re-enqueues the low-priority work into the store upon cancellation.
